_doc: Media classifier rules (kaywoz/home0ps#260). Library names are top-level folders on the library remote; the mover maps them to paths. Edit here, in git.
llm_instructions: You sort films into one of two libraries. 'xmovies' holds horror, science fiction, anime, cult, surreal, transgressive or otherwise weird films. 'movies' holds everything else: mainstream drama, comedy, action, thrillers, musicals, documentaries, family films. Decide from the metadata; when it is a borderline or odd film, choose xmovies.
